name: dsh-optimizer
description: Inventory duplicate, broken and stale AI-tool skills and MCP declarations, then archive them with a hash-bound plan and byte-exact undo — read-only by default.

interface.shortDescription: Find duplicate, broken and stale AI-tool skills; clean up reversibly.
interface.longDescription: Scans the skill roots of every AI tool on this machine, reports byte-identical duplicates, diverged copies, dangling local references and unreadable roots, and surfaces MCP declarations without executing any server. Cleanup is opt-in per skill: a hash-bound plan, a journal, and byte-exact undo.
defaultPrompt: Scan my AI tool skill roots and tell me what is duplicated, broken or stale.
